meta.product: Dior skincare sold at Sephora: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum, Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream, Capture Totale firming cream, and Cica Recover Balm
meta.brand_context:
Brand: Dior, a French luxury house. Skincare lines: Capture Totale (anti-ageing, "backed by over 40 years of stem cell research") and Cica (repair for stressed skin). Sold at Sephora at premium prices.
Brand promises:
- Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum: eyes look younger, less puffiness from the first week, fewer dark circles and fine lines, firmer and brighter eye contour, hydration, a fresh cooling feel, applied with the 360 Cryo-Flex massaging applicator.
- Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream: rich texture, age-defying correction of wrinkles and firmness, "seals in" benefits.
- Capture Totale firming cream: firmer, more visibly revitalised skin.
- Cica Recover Balm: regenerating multi-use balm for face and body, long-lasting hydration, soothes discomfort, suitable even for the most sensitive skin, no oily or sticky film, no synthetic fragrance.
Audience: adults who buy premium anti-ageing skincare and expect luxury-level, visible results for the price.
meta.topics:
results: visible effect on wrinkles, firmness, dark circles, puffiness, glow, or no visible effect
hydration: moisture, nourishment, dryness
texture: how it feels on the skin, rich, heavy, greasy, sticky or light
scent: smell or fragrance, too strong, perfume-like, fragrance-free expectations
irritation: breakouts, burning, redness, allergic reactions
packaging: jar, pump, bottle, applicator, hygiene, leaking
price: cost and value for money

reviews: The product itself is good. It’s a lightweight serum that quickly absorbs into the skin. It left my undereyes feeling hydrated which in turn does reduce the appearance of the fine lines that I have under there. It is lightly scented, but nothing that is too overpowering or irritating to the senses. The packaging could use some work.  I feel like I have to use quite a bit of pressure to get some product out.  And the applicator tip seemed too big and wasn’t comfortable to use under my eye.  I opted to squeeze some product on my ring finger and applied it that way. Overall it’s a good product but at the price point it is,  I would choose a different, more Affordable product that has the same results.

The formulation itself is great. It is scented however it was not too strong and it didn’t irritate my eyes. The eye cream is light and goes on smooth. My under eyes feel nice and hydrated after each use. I did not notice much improvement with puffiness but the hydration did make my fine lines appear more diminished. I used this every night for about a month. The applicator requires too much pressure to get product out. Though I love the concept, I prefer to have a simple tube to squirt product out as needed on my fingers. I honestly don’t plan on purchasing this. There are plenty of other eye creams that will achieve the same effect for less.

I received this product to try out in a voxbox. The main thing I really like about this product is the applicator. It’s elongated oval shape really lets you get in there and the grooves help to make sure you’re evenly distributing the product. The applicator is made of metal which gives a cool massaging feel when applying serum.The serum itself has a good consistency. It’s not runny but it’s not thick either. The fragrance is very light and not overpowering.While using this product, I did notice some slight smoothing of the skin in terms of fine lines with n my under-eye area but not to the degree that the packaging makes it seem like you will experience. My eyes never appeared larger and my bags did not appear lifted as the product claims. I definitely would not spent the $80 this product retails for based on my results. It definitely feels like they’re charging more for the name than actual performance/serum results. I like this product but I don’t love it.

I received this item complimentary from Influenster & Dior in exchange for my honest review. I was super excited to try this product out. I really like the packaging and the application process. The serum aborns very easily and feels good on the skin. I have been using every night for about three weeks now and haven’t seen any improvements though. So I was shocked when I saw this was recommended by 90% of reviewers. Is it a nice eye serum? Yes, but if it’s not actually doing anything than I can’t see myself purchasing this in the future. I would have expected some results by now. I’m going to continue using it and hope for the best. To each is own, try at your own risk

I was fortunate enough to be chosen to sample this eye serum for my honest opinion on it. I absolutely loved the tip on it. The metal felt good spreading the serum under my eyes. I felt that it definitely helped with the puffiness and bags under my eyes that I tend to suffer with daily (no matter hope much sleep I get or water I drink) but I felt it didn’t help at all with the fine lines and wrinkles I have around my eyes. I also wasn’t thrilled about how strong it is scented. It actually made my eyes water when I applied it because the smell was so strong. I’m glad I was given the opportunity to try this but I think I’ll stick with the eye serum I’ve been using that costs only a fraction of the price of this Dior serum

The product is overall, easy to apply and rather convenient given its design. The applicator is pretty neat but short lived, considering it’s supposed to feel nice and cool since it’s metal but it quickly warms up after finishing one eye. Prior to using this specific product, my eyes were in decent condition as I already had a product I was using prior to receiving this. Not puffy or dark, but just some little lines here and there. I stopped using my daily eye creams and just used the Dior product once in the AM and once in the PM so I can get a true review of the effects. The results were very slight for me personally- again, I don’t have a lot of wrinkles or eye issues, just some light wrinkles. I began seeing results after 2 consecutive weeks of use, the lines became more faint than they were when I first started using this product. By week 3 and 4, there was minimal change and I was okay with that. For $80, it’s a steep price - I saw similar results for a product that runs $54. The trick to these eye creams is that when you do stop using it, the lines return so it’s not a permanent solution and I saw this when I forgot to pack this during vacation to Aruba for a week. When I returned the same results came back. Overall, I would recommend if you want something luxurious. It does what it says, but only as long as you continue to use the product. Maybe I need to finish the entire bottle before permanent results, however I haven’t gotten to that point yet.

The applicator is so nice it felt cooling and it glides so smooth no tugging on that delicate skin, unfortunately the serum is kinda scented and it made my eyes water and sting a little instantly, I gave it to my mom and she loves it, I haven’t seen much change in her burly isn’t only been a week or so. I got it from influenster

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review from Influenster. The eye serum is a medium weight thickness that isn’t runny or too creamy and applies with a smooth oval metal applicator. The applicator feels nice on the skin but is a bit awkward to fit in the tear duct/inner corner area. The serum feels nice and hydrating but pretty sticky if you apply to the eye lids.  I feel like my under eyes look a bit plumper and brighter but nothing dramatically improved and the affects seem pretty temporary. I don’t notice my fine lines being diminished after use or over time and I’ve tested this product nightly for about a month. Maybe it would be more noticeable if I had more defined wrinkles but for the price, there’s better more affordable options out there.

I was super excited to try this product as I usually love all things Dior. This serum is silky smooth and I love the applicator on the product but I’ll admit that I haven’t seen any noticeable difference. I feel like these products usually take some time to see any improvement or changes and thus far, not much. But a good eye serum is important so I’ll keep using and see what happens!

The packaging is the biggest flaw. It’s a hard plastic you have to try to squeeze to get the product out. If you squeeze too hard, too much comes out. The metal tip is nice and cooling, but will drag if you don’t have enough product on it. The serum itself was nice. I found it hydrated my under eyes, but didn’t notice any reduction of wrinkles. It didn’t irritate my eyes and played nice with my skin.

Nice, cooling effect with the applicator. The product didn’t bother my eyes or cause a migraine, which is always good. The results were too slight for me to splurge on this in the future. I’ll continue using the one I have and if I see better results, I’ll edit my review (if that’s possible).

First off. It feels great under the eyes. When I use the the silver applicator to apply the eye serum under my eyes, it provides a cooling effect. However I don’t like how the product sits on my face after using that applicator so I have to use my finger to rub it into my skin. It has a slight fragrance to it. Did I see any results, well I notice a small difference in my under eye lines so that’s about it. I’ll just pass on this product.

I have been using this product for a couple of weeks now. I like the applicator as it feels cool and comfortable when applying. The serum feels nice on my skin but honestly I haven’t noticed a substantial difference in puffiness or darkness. Overall it’s a nice product but for the price I probably would not repurchase.

I received this product for free from Influenster & Dior in exchange for my honest opinion. This eye serum was okay. Nothing spectacular or particularly different from others I’ve tried. I used this product daily for almost a solid month & had no notable changes to the darkness or fine lines. It is a nice formula, it goes on smoothly, absorbs well, & dries to a smooth finish. The application is really nice with the metal tip that does help reduce puffiness.

I did notice a slight reduction in my dark circles and my puffiness but not enough that I would buy the product outright.

reviews: This cream is okay, but I’m not a fan of the very strong, heavy scent

Whe I received the product I was having a hard time opening and closing lid. Not sure if the alignment was off or it was me. The cream was very rich and creamy so it moisturized well. I did think the smell was a little strong for a facial cream but did smell nice. I did receive this cream as complimentary and I am not sure I would pay that much for this cream in the future.

I received this for free from Influenster to review. Like most Dior products, it is heavily scented. The first day I applied it, I found it to be a nice product. It went on smoothly for as thick as it was. I did not experience burning on the dry patches on my face. It did not leave my skin feeling greasy. However, the next time I applied it, the smell was too strong for me that day and I ended up with a migraine. I’ve been afraid to use it since then.

First of all, I received this product for free to review and test from Influenster. I have used this for almost a month now, twice a day. Once in the morning and once before bed. I have combination skin and to me it is a heavy moisturizer but soaks in very quick and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy. It did make my face feel very hydrated, but at the end of this month I really haven’t seen much of a difference in my skin!! It comes with a cute little spoon to apply the creme which I loved. I wasn’t a fan of the lid on the jar. It was a little aggravating to open and close. The smell is nice and light. It isn’t a bad product, but to me the price is too high for not much improvement in my skin.

This cream is wonderful it just wasn’t for me. My skin is dry in the winter and needs something with more moisture punch but this was too balmy for my skin and didn’t absorb nicely. This cream has a lingering beautiful floral scent so it may not be for you based on that alone. If you have intensely dry skin this is definitely something to grab.

This Dior cream is very potent and rich as the name claims. It is thick, but feels light on the skin. It should be a win with how well it moisturizes, however, the scent is so strong that it is completely overwhelming. I wouldn’t consider myself sensitive to fragrances and it made me gag. I can’t say if it reduces fine lines and wrinkles, because I couldn’t continue using it with the heavy smell. I wish they made an unscented version as I really love the cream itself!

I received this product for free to try from Influenster for a complimentary review. I can’t say that I am impressed with this product. I do like the look of the packaging and the cream itself, and I really appreciate that it has a little spoon to avoid contamination of the product. I also like that a little goes a long way, so you don’t have to use that many product. I don’t like that the scent is too strong (it has a perfume scent) and I feel it’s a little on the oily side. For dry skin this may work great, but for normal or combination skin, I would not recommend it as a daytime cream. It may work as a nighttime cream. I think it is on the expensive side, so I wouldn’t recommend for someone with normal or combination skin since it is too heavy and will likely only use it for nighttime, it is more worth the money for someone with dry skin since a little goes a long way and that type of skin will really take benefit off of it.

I really wanted to like this but unfortunately my skin did not like it. And it is very scented, it’s not a bad scent but it is very strong and lasts a long time.It is very a good moisturizer and it sinks in very nice and doesn’t leave a greasy feeling at all. Unfortunately my skin reacted badly to it from the fragrance. If you don’t have sensitive skin I would recommend it.I received this product free for testing purposes.
This product was ok. Not a fan of the sensation it gave me on my face. But I like it helped with fine lines. Tip: keep away from your lip line it gave me a undesirable feeling

I received this product free from Influenster. I am combo mostly oily skin type so I don’t use this product often. I can’t speak to its anti aging benefits because I am in my 20s but it is thick, creamy and rich. I like to layer hydrating serums and mists on my skin before sealing them in with this product at night. Beware if you are sensitive to fragrances. It’s not an in pleasant clean floral smell but if you don’t like scented skincare stay away.

I received this product free from Influenster to try. I want to start by saying this product is not really right for me as I have combo skin that can get oily. This cream is true to the claims that it is super rich! It is a thick almost balmy consistency in the jar. I don’t particularly care for how it feels on my skin- feels quite heavy. After applying, I noticed my face was pretty greasy. I bet if you have dry skin, it’d be great and give you a dewy look, but if you have combo skin or are oily at all, I would stay away or try the non-super-rich version.

I received this product from Influenster for my honest opinion. The jar is glass, heavy weighted, looks and feels luxurious. It came with a plastic spatula which was a nice touch but nowhere to store it. I would have liked to have seen a place to store it in the cap. I feel there was definitely a missed opportunity there. If you are going to go through the trouble of providing a spatula please provide a place in the cap to store it for easy access to it as well as to keep it sanitary. I ended up not using the spatula at all due to having to store it somewhere else that I would have to locate it first in order to utilize this feature. The jar itself was extremely hard to open for the first time. It would not open for me at all. I tried for hours to get the jar open only to finally give up on it for the night. The next morning I was finally able to get the jar opened and I was excited to start using the product. Upon opening the jar and removing the plastic protector I was immediately put off by the extreme scent of roses. I am not opposed to fragrance in skincare at all and I actually enjoy the scent of roses but the scent is overwhelming in my opinion. I suffer from migraines and over the top fragrance can trigger reactionary migraines for me. I am happy to report that even though it is extremely fragranced this product did not cause any reactionary migraines. The cream is thick,  luxurious and absorbed into the skin well. Even though the cream is thicker in consistency you do not need much of the product to cover your face, neck and décolletage. I did experience some pilling when combined with my other serums with this product so I stopped using it at night and used only in the morning without using my essence, serums or oils. I did not notice any significant improvement in wrinkles or firmness of the skin. I did notice a boost in radiance overall but this was not enough for me to repurchase this product sadly.

This cream didn’t seem to do much for my skin. It was a nice moisturizer and has a beautiful perfume scent (which is actually pretty strong, if you’re not into that)- but I wouldn’t say it did anything beyond adding some moisture. For the price, I would expect it to do more, but I saw no differences in my skin. If you’re looking for a basic moisturizer, I would find something more affordable. If you want something to help with skin tone and/or wrinkles, look elsewhere.

The cream is thick and heavily scented but provides little moisturizing benefits. After 2-3 weeks my skin started getting dry and flaky. I received this from Influenster to give my honest review. The jar is glass, heavy weighted, looks and feels luxurious. It came with a plastic spatula which was a nice touch but nowhere to store it. I would have liked to have seen a place to store it in the cap. I feel there was definitely a missed opportunity there. If you are going to go through the trouble of providing a spatula please provide a place in the cap to store it for easy access to it as well as to keep it sanitary. I ended up not using the spatula at all due to having to store it somewhere else that I would have to locate it first in order to utilize this feature. The jar itself was extremely hard to open for the first time. It would not open for me at all. I tried for hours to get the jar open only to finally give up on it for the night. The next morning I was finally able to get the jar opened and I was excited to start using the product. Upon opening the jar and removing the plastic protector I was immediately put off by the extreme scent of roses. I am not opposed to fragrance in skincare at all and I actually enjoy the scent of roses but the scent is overwhelming in my opinion. I suffer from migraines and over the top fragrance can trigger reactionary migraines for me. I am happy to report that even though it is extremely fragranced this product did not cause any reactionary migraines. The cream is thick,  luxurious and absorbed into the skin well. Even though the cream is thicker in consistency you do not need much of the product to cover your face, neck and décolletage. I did experience some pilling when combined with my other serums with this product so I stopped using it at night and used only in the morning without using my essence, serums or oils. I did not notice any significant reduction in wrinkles or firmness or the skin. I did notice a boost in radiance of my skin but honestly this is not enough to repurchase sadly.

Sure it felt amazing , and it made my skin feel nice and supple, however at this price point it should. It did make my face seem hydrated. The one big thing that I disliked was the packaging. I hated the “ spatula“ that Dior used . For this price, putting a plastic spoon took away from its elegance overall. I hated that I had to place the spoon under the lid nightly. It was not a good design. Comparing this to the Tatcha brand which is cheaper the design is much better. Tatcha has a holder at the top and is with a metal spoon where Dior’s  is just a plastic spatula. Dior is supposed to be a brand that is Luxe and this cream just did not scream all 5 stars. For the smell, it was not overpowering like I exoected. It was lightweight. A little bit of cream does go a long way. I did like using this, but I would not purchase it even though I am able. It does not set itself apart from the rest. A brand name cream at this price point should be amazing all around. This is not. I cannot recommend this based on price.

I think I would reach for other high end skincare products first. It does hydrate and soothe the skin nicely, and I enjoy using it as the last step in my nighttime skincare routine. I apply a dime sized amount to my face and neck to lock in moisture. It worked well in calming my skin after have sensitivity due to retinol. I don’t apply too much because the balm texture can become sticky if too much product is applied. I also like using it as a mask, applying a thick layer for 10 mins then wiping away the excess. I used Dior’s Cica Recover and Repair Multiuse Balm for 2 weeks while stopping all other skincare to fairly assess its strengths. My first impression of the minimalist packaging and tube was that it might be a no nonsense, highly effective product. It has a very mild gentle fragrance which may come specifically from its ingredients and not added perfumes and dyes. I have some sensitivity and hyperpigmentation issues from reactions occasionally, so this was much appreciated. The cream itself is balmy in texture, but spreads easily and doesn’t leave a greasy feel behind. A little doesn’t go a long way, and I needed about 2 large pea size dollops to cover my whole face and neck. It spread easily and sank in without leaving a greasy film, but I didn’t feel that it moisturized extraordinarily well. It was good nevertheless, and my skin felt adequately soft while I wore it. It also seemed to calm some rashes and irritation i developed from a new cleanser last week. With the Dior name, the minimalist packaging and quality ingredients I expected this cream to blow me out of the water. Perhaps my expectations were a little high. With those managed, I would say this is a good if not great moisturizer.
